name: unieai/claude-code
description: UnieAI dsh genome: production-grade Claude-Code working mode plus a hardened security posture. Scaffold/config only; no model-weights change.

source.methodology: CosmosMind-ai/RSI-Harness genome (instructions, tools, skills, commands, model, runtime, policies, integrations, appearance, settings, keybindings, resources)

harness.note: Applied as dsh declarative config (Cordis patch + env) rather than a separate genome CLI. dsh has no generic appendSystemPrompt/tool-schema-narrowing knob, so components map onto real dsh config keys where possible and are documented as gaps otherwise.

instructions.dsh_mapping: system-prompt.config.personaPrefix (deployment-authored system-prompt fragment); plan-mode.config.section for plan mode; agent-instructions auto-discovers AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md.

tools.dsh_mapping: Cordis patch rows keyed by plugin id (tool-bash, tool-fs, tool-fs-search, tool-web, tool-subagent). Global disable via disabled:true; narrowing via tool-web search/fetch + caps, subagent.toolFilter, sandbox read-only preset. Model-facing names differ from plugin ids.

skills.dsh_mapping: tool-skill + auto-discovered skill files; loaded at runtime, not genome config.

commands.dsh_mapping: dsh command/agent presets (agent-preset composition); not carried by this genome.

model.dsh_mapping: agent-loop agents[] (id, model, provider, maxTokens). Intentionally NOT set — the constraint is no model change; left to the deployment.

runtime.dsh_mapping: agent-loop.maxParallelToolCalls (1 = serial, deterministic), subagent.maxDepth, per-tool timeout-policy.timeoutMs. Whole-run maxTurns/deadline has NO declarative dsh key; use unieai-loop-guard (UNIEAI_TURN_MAX_STEPS / UNIEAI_TURN_DEADLINE_MS) and goal.maxGoalRounds (per-goal).

policies.dsh_mapping: sandbox-policy.mode (workspace-write default; read-only for CI/reviews), permission presets (declarative), secret redaction via @unieai/uac-plugins secret-redact, subagent jobs access-control (owner isolation). No dsh native danger-command blocklist — a guard plugin is noted.

integrations.dsh_mapping: @unieai/uac-plugins selected by profile (cli/studio) and rendered as - insert: patch rows; loaded via --patch <file>.

settings.dsh_mapping: Deployment overrides live in the patch; user/local state is $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml applied after the profile and before --patch.

keybindings.dsh_mapping: n/a (CLI agent loop; not part of this genome).

resources.dsh_mapping: resource isolation and auto-discovery toggles are per-plugin; RSI-Harness resources.isolate is NOT a dsh config key (gap).
